entities.summary: Georgi (Gia) Dvali is a Georgian theoretical physicist. He is a professor of theoretical physics at LMU Munich, a director at the Max Planck Institute for Physics in Munich, and holds a Silver Professorship Chair at the New York University. His research interests include String theory, Extra dimensions, Quantum gravity, and the Early universe.
